chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, and Husayn ibn Uthman, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The absentee, when he intends to divorce her, should leave her for a month.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a husband who is away when he wants to divorce his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific mechanism for 'divorce by the absentee' (al-gha'ib), where the husband's absence prevents immediate physical delivery of the divorce pronouncement. It stipulates a one-month waiting period to determine if he returns, thereby clarifying the status of the marriage and the commencement of the waiting period (iddah) in the context of Shia fiqh.
